text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes all 16 tests. I changed only code in `catalog/`, not the tests.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`, where `normalize` is defined.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the comment and tests say five. I set it to 5.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing a third book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my choice, since the tests only check the title.
